policy.title: Darkest Dungeon 1 Trinket Guidance & Synergies
policy.disclaimer: Curated tactical ratings, class synergies, and usage cautions. Ratings represent baseline recommendations and should adapt to expedition goals, light levels, and dungeon hazards.

synergies: Leper, Crusader, and other low-accuracy frontline attackers
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: One of the best universal offensive trinkets, fixing accuracy deficits while boosting critical hit chance.

synergies: Radiant and high torchlight party compositions
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Standard offensive powerhouse when maintaining light above 75, granting substantial damage and accuracy.

synergies: Pitch black and dark dungeon crawling
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Mirror to Sun Ring for dark runs, providing heavy offensive stats in zero torchlight.

synergies: Fast offensive openers and mobile attackers in radiant light
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Superb high-light stat bundle granting SPD, DMG, and DODGE for front-line and back-line attackers.

synergies: Dungeon exploration, surprise chance manipulation, secret room discovery
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Essential scouting trinket that prevents party surprises, detects traps, and reveals secret rooms.

synergies: High-base damage melee skills like Chop, Wicked Hack, and Collect Bounty
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Premier melee damage amplifier that significantly boosts raw output and critical strike rates.

synergies: Sniper Shot, Pistol Shot, and Flashing Daggers
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Top-tier ranged enhancement for dedicated backline marksmen.

synergies: Dedicated healers and stress recovery specialists
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Dual-purpose utility trinket maximizing both HP recovery and stress restoration.

synergies: Frontline anchors requiring protection and hit consistency
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Flawless defensive and offensive hybrid granting PROT, ACC, and stress resistance without penalty.

synergies: Blinding Gas double-stun and backline Plague Grenade blights
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: The gold standard class trinket, granting overwhelming stun chance, blight chance, and ranged accuracy.

synergies: Divine Grace single-target and Divine Comfort party heals
cautions: Reduces stun skill chance by 33% and lowers damage.
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Heavy heal booster turning Vestal into a dedicated recovery turret at the expense of stun utility.

synergies: Vestals seeking healing output while retaining Dazzling Light stuns
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Preferred healing trinket when you want strong heals without sacrificing stun accuracy.

synergies: Raw burst damage dealers
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: High-risk, high-reward burst item granting +25% raw damage.

synergies: Protection stacking and guard abilities like Defender
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Grants +25% PROT, enabling frontline tanks to shrug off massive physical strikes.

synergies: Primary healers needing strong output before Ancestor's Scroll
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Massive +30% heal increase, highly effective if stress healing is available in the party.

synergies: Round 1 priority stuns, marks, or critical buff setup
cautions: Speed bonus applies only on round one.
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Guarantees round-one tempo advantage to disable dangerous enemies before they act.

synergies: Fast attackers and mobile sweepers
cautions: Increases stress taken by 15% and reduces virtue chance.
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Combines substantial speed (+3 SPD) and damage for aggressive offensive pacing.

synergies: Blackjack rank 1-3 stuns
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Elevates Houndmaster's Blackjack into one of the most dependable stuns in the game.

synergies: Hound's Rush bleed attacks against beasts and eldritch
cautions: Reduces healing received and maximum HP.
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Turns Houndmaster into a premier physical and bleed damage dealer.

synergies: Hound's Watch camping skill and dungeon navigation
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Consistent scouting bonus that dramatically reduces dungeon hazard encounters.

synergies: Hands from the Abyss frontline stuns and Vulnerability Hex
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Transforms rank 1 or 2 Occultist into an elite stunner and debuffer.

synergies: Rampart stun and knockback cycling
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Greatly boosts Rampart stun and move chances, locking down priority enemy targets.

synergies: Rank 4 Guard and Command setup
cautions: Effects only apply when positioned in rank 4.
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Enables a unique backline protector playstyle with massive PROT, DODGE, and healing received.

synergies: Chop, Hew, and Revenge offensive sequencing
cautions: Reduces virtue chance and increases stress taken.
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Solves Leper's sluggish base speed, letting him strike before enemies take their turns.

synergies: Compensating for Leper's severe base accuracy deficit
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Crucial class accuracy correction ensuring Leper's massive base damage connects reliably.

synergies: Iron Swan and Wicked Hack in high torchlight
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Outstanding high-light trinket providing top-tier accuracy and crit with zero downside.

synergies: Duelist's Advance, Open Vein, and Riposte counterattacks
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Specialized melee booster maximizing Highwayman's Riposte and Open Vein bleed crits.

synergies: Lunge burst setups, trap disarming, and surprise avoidance
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Premier all-in-one class trinket offering SPD, Crit, Trap Disarm, and Scouting simultaneously.

synergies: Fast utility supports, Jester, Grave Robber, and dodge builders
cautions: Reduces stun and move resistance by 10%.
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Top utility stat package giving +2 SPD and +8 DODGE with negligible drawbacks.

synergies: Occultist heal recipients, Leper, and Flagellant
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Boosts incoming heals by 40%, ensuring any single heal fully restores the wearer.

synergies: Long expeditions, Darkest Dungeon quests, stress-fragile heroes
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Clean -20% stress damage mitigation with zero stat penalty.

synergies: Stress-vulnerable heroes and dark run crawling
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Huge -25% stress reduction awarded from defeating the Madman.

synergies: Low-HP heroes like Plague Doctor, Grave Robber, and Antiquarian
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Substantial +25% maximum HP buffer against sudden death checks.

synergies: Primary damage dealers and fast control heroes
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Premier aggressive music box granting +2 SPD and +15% raw damage universally.

synergies: Death's Door buffer and last-stand survivability
cautions: Maximum stat benefits trigger only when at Death's Door.
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: High-stakes safety net that massively boosts damage, crit, and death blow resist near death.

synergies: Warrens and Weald expeditions, front-line blight/bleed absorbers
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Provides sweeping resistance to Blight, Bleed, and Disease, effectively neutralizing dungeon hazards.

synergies: Early game healing enhancement
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Solid early-game +15% healing increase with zero downside.

synergies: Stunning Blow frontline lockdown
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Significantly improves Crusader's Stunning Blow consistency against high-resist enemies.

synergies: Inspiring Tune stress reduction in high light
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Unmatched radiant stress healing booster turning Jester into a bottomless stress relief fountain.

synergies: Transform spam and prolonged Beast form sustain
trinkets.playstyleAdvice: Drastically cuts party transformation stress, allowing Abomination to fight freely in beast form.
